contract: docs/specs/V8_CONTRACT_20261008.json (verify() must pass before any run)
question: Does any tuned long-only stock/ETF strategy, selected only on past data, beat simply owning the benchmarks after realistic costs, out of sample?

inputs.bars: contract bars_1h and bars_1d, adjusted OHLCV for signals, raw prices for costs
inputs.holdout: 2026-01-01 onward is not read by any stage-1 code (stage 5)

strategies.direction: long only (user decision 2026-10-08; shorts and bearish puts are a later, separate test)
strategies.families_catalog: nn_meta.multitimeframe_catalog legacy families with their registered grids: ma 2485, rsi 100, macd 51, volume 48, elliott 24, keltner 25, bbands 20, supertrend 15, stoch 12, squeeze 9, bbw_squeeze 9, tv_rating 6 (2,804 variants)
strategies.families_new_volume: nn_meta.v8_signals: rvol_surge, obv_trend, vwap_reclaim (rolling bar VWAP), adl_breakout (small grids, listed in code)
strategies.excluded: The 13 TradingView-source variants (tv_setup, tv_amd, tv_fibonacci, tv_gaussian, tv_msb, tv_rsi_probability, tv_sr, tv_uptrick) depend on intraday session context (VWAP/opening observations, higher-timeframe flags) with no defined hourly/daily semantics; excluded rather than reinterpreted.
strategies.signal_timing: a signal computed on bar t's close executes at the next execution point

execution.1h: next bar's open; entries only at bars opening at or after 10:00 ET (i.e. not the 09:30 bar); exits allowed at any bar
execution.1d: next trading day at the 10:30 ET hourly bar's open (entries and exits)
execution.admission: entries only on admitted (ticker, date) rows of the contract admission panel
execution.forced_exits: at the last bar before a missing day, delisting or events.json break (at that bar's close, with sell costs)
execution.costs: nn_meta.v8_fills stock half-spread x name factor + 1 bp slippage per side, sell fees; cost multiplier 1.0 primary, 1.5 stress

portfolio.sizing: each entry takes 1/10 of current equity (capped by cash); no leverage; idle cash earns 0
portfolio.entry_priority: when entries exceed free slots: higher trailing 20-day median dollar volume first (adv20 from the admission panel), ticker as tie-break
portfolio.kelly: out of scope for the edge test; half-Kelly sizing with per-position and gross caps is defined later for the paper simulator using out-of-sample fold statistics only

evaluation.returns: daily portfolio returns from 2021-05-03 (first admitted day)
evaluation.in_sample: expanding: 2021-05-03 up to the day before each fold
evaluation.selection: highest in-sample annualized Sharpe among variants with >= 30 in-sample round trips; pooled across both timeframes
benchmarks: equal-weight admitted universe (daily rebalanced, close to close, no costs)

pass_rules_all_required.beat_benchmarks: top-1 out-of-sample fold return exceeds every benchmark's fold return in >= 4 of 6 folds, at cost multiplier 1.0
pass_rules_all_required.rank_persistence: Spearman(in-sample Sharpe, out-of-sample Sharpe) across eligible variants is positive in >= 4 of 6 folds and its median >= 0.10
pass_rules_all_required.deflated_sharpe: probability >= 0.95 for the concatenated top-1 out-of-sample daily returns, N = all variants evaluated (both timeframes), Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014)
pass_rules_all_required.pbo: CSCV probability of backtest overfitting < 0.5 over 2021-05-03..2025-12-31 daily returns of all variants, 16 contiguous blocks
pass_rules_all_required.cost_stress: beat_benchmarks still holds when the whole procedure is rerun at cost multiplier 1.5

if_nothing_passes: Record the verdict in EXPERIMENTS; stage 2 (volatility) is next, not a meta-model.
